semantics: This is the final operational Edition-routing release for the 508 Editions inside the 17 human-SPLIT predecessor project works.
The six registry-remediated predecessor projects use frozen LLM routing v2 as their base; the other eleven projects retain frozen LLM routing v1 as base.
All 118 human-reviewed Edition rows are human-authoritative in the final release.
For 112 rows with direct human ASSIGN or HOLD decisions, the human decision overrides or confirms the LLM base.
For the six former REGISTRY_ISSUE rows, the final component is the human-added registry-v2 component; the fresh v2 LLM routing independently agreed with all six.
The remaining 390 unreviewed rows retain their frozen operational LLM routing.
HOLD_UNRESOLVED is preserved as explicit uncertainty and is not treated as failure.
A routing component is an Edition-routing ontology label, not a project_work_id or source_entity_id.
DETACH and EXCLUDE_APPARATUS are component role hints and do not themselves constitute corpus-scope decisions.
This release does not create successor project works, source entities, lineage edges, or scope decisions.
